title: Building a D&D-style fantasy RPG where you can gather a party and go on adventures
author: tschilpi
selftext:
My aim is to capture the spirit of a great D&D session: adventurers heading into dangerous territory, committing to questionable plans, and dealing with NPCs who have their own motivations and aren't necessarily on your side.

* Gather your adventurers and head into the frontier
* Negotiate with hobgoblins, haggle with merchants, and see how your party gets along
* Get caught in rivalries, make deals, pick sides, or start a fight
* Improvise when your plans go sideways and see how the world reacts

I've been building this for 3 years, and I'm having way too much fun with the latest patch.

**Try it out:** [https://www.llmsaga.com/](https://www.llmsaga.com/)  
**Follow development:** [https://discord.gg/Cr3pQx6SXE](https://discord.gg/Cr3pQx6SXE)
